caption:
Every GTA ranked by sales 👑 Last reported numbers.

B tier: GTA III (14.5M) and Vice City (17.5M), both as of March 2008. A tier: GTA IV (25M+) and San Andreas (27.5M). S tier, alone: GTA V, over 230 million.

GTA 6 is too new for a unit count (Take-Two has only reported $3.79B in pre-orders + day one). Where will it land? 👇

Sources: Take-Two, PC Gamer, Statista, Sportskeeda, Twinfinite.

Fan page, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
